metadata.title: Preparing for Capacitor 9: What App and Plugin Teams Can Do Now
metadata.description: Capacitor 9 raises the bar on Node, Xcode, Android Gradle, and deprecated native APIs. Here is how to get ready on Capacitor 8 before you flip the version switch, including Cordova optional sync, CLI live reload, and Capgo OTA store builds.
metadata.author: Martin Donadieu
